init.title: Choose the camera preview source
init.description:
Choose the source of the preview image shown in the camera card when you are not watching video. This setting applies only to gate cameras and does not affect live video.

Server snapshots are cached in memory: if a refresh fails, the last successful image remains visible. It may be outdated; restarting Home Assistant clears the cache.

Saving this setting briefly reloads Intelpark.

error.invalid_preview_source: Select one of the available preview sources.
